children: Shanti B. Gupta, an officer serving as Chief Operating Officer, reported a weighted average sale price of $58.89 per share for Class A Common Stock. The report shows total proceeds of $706,680 from the sale of 12,000 shares. Following the transaction, Gupta directly owns 462,980 Class A Common Stock. The filing states the shares were sold in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $58.87 to $58.93 per share and that the reporting person will provide details of the number of shares sold at each price upon request.
